🛡 Sturdy and Reliable: fanxiang has built a drive that's not only fast but also durable. The S660 is crafted to endure, ensuring your data is safe and accessible for years to come.
🌡 Efficient Thermal Management: Despite its power, the drive remains cool under pressure, thanks to its advanced thermal solutions. No more worrying about overheating during intense tasks.
🔍 Ultra-Compact Form Factor: The M.2 design ensures that the S660 occupies minimal space, making it perfect for both desktops and laptops. It's amazing how much power is packed into such a compact design.
🔄 Seamless Integration: Installing and setting up the S660 was a breeze. It seamlessly integrates with various systems, proving its versatility and user-friendliness.
In summing up, the fanxiang S660 4TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe M.2 SSD is the epitome of modern storage solutions. It's a blend of speed, capacity, and reliability that's hard to come by. If you're looking to elevate your computing experience to the next level, the S660 is not just an option; it's the only choice!

reviews.title: Beyond expectation.
reviews.comment:
I opted for the fanxiang SSD. I'm thrilled to report that this drive has exceeded my expectations, providing a phenomenal gaming experience that's both smooth and reliable.
The installation process was remarkably straightforward. Even for someone who isn't particularly tech-savvy, the fanxiang SSD fit perfectly into the PS5 Slim's expansion slot, and the console recognized it instantly. Within minutes, I was ready to transfer games and dive back into my digital library.
Performance is where the fanxiang SSD truly shines. I've put it through its paces with a variety of demanding titles, and I'm genuinely impressed. There's absolutely no noticeable lag in game loading times or during gameplay. Transitions between areas are buttery smooth, and textures load crisply, contributing to a truly immersive experience.
I've embarked on several extended gaming sessions, sometimes for hours on end, and the fanxiang SSD has handled everything without a hitch. There have been no crashes, no stutters, and no performance drops whatsoever. It operates flawlessly, ensuring that my gaming adventures remain uninterrupted and enjoyable.
In conclusion, I am incredibly satisfied with my fanxiang SSD purchase for the PS5 Slim. It's a high-performing, easy-to-install, and utterly reliable storage solution that has significantly enhanced my gaming setup. If you're looking to expand your PS5 Slim's storage and want a worry-free upgrade, I can wholeheartedly recommend the fanxiang SSD.

reviews.title: I'm starting to become a BIG FAN of fanxiang!
reviews.comment:
DISCLAIMER ABOUT NEGATIVE REVIEWS saying these drives aren't as fast as fanxiang claims:  These drives ARE FAST and in most cases, they are probably faster than the customer's systems are capable of achieving.
I've been upgrading several of my computers over the past 6 months and happened upon fanxiang branded 2.5" SSDs and decided to try a few mainly because they were less expensive than most other brands with similar specs.  Sure enough, the data speeds were as promised (using CrystalDiskMark) and then I tried one of their smaller (1TB) m.2 drives and was also pleased with not only the performance but also again, their lower price compared to similar brands.  So...  I decided to 'go big' and got the 4 TB m.2 but decided to go for the 5000 MB/s instead of the faster one (7300 MB/s) simply because my system couldn't even make full use of the 5000 MB/s speed.
This drive replaced a smaller 1 TB Sabrent Rocket (gen 4) and actually beat the read speed by 1000 MB/s while the write speeds were almost identical.
I am thrilled with the performance, formatting was simple, and I quickly transferred around 350 GB from my smaller m.2 SSD to this one in a matter of minutes.  While I have only been using fanxiang hard drives for about 6 months, I have not had any issues, but don't have a long enough history using them to comment on how well these last over a period of years.  What I can say, is that they are less expensive than other brands of similar specs.  Again, I just want to stress what I mentioned at the start of my review.  These ARE fast drives, in many cases, the limitations are going to be from the motherboard itself, and also, transfer speeds (in actual use) will also vary based on the size of the files being transferred (transferring small files is much slower than transferring larger files).
